text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka stared intently at her 
empty dishes after lunch.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm, the race is coming up soon too... 
What should I do...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san... Um, I'm trying to 
decide whether I should have dessert or 
not.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Right now, there's actually a 
limited-time Snow Fair going on."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's full of beautiful dishes inspired by 
pure white, snowy landscapes...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Among them, the 'Snow-Viewing Kamakura 
Jumbo Parfait' is the one I'm especially 
curious about."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Still, the race is coming up soon, so I'm 
worried about my weight and all...
choice_data_list: Want to split it and share?
Let's not worry and just eat it up!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you sure...? Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... It's so sweet and pretty, it 
almost feels like a waste to eat it...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...If you say so, Trainer, then it's 
really okay... right...?"
choice_data_list: Just run off whatever you eat.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah..., Eating whatever you want and 
running as much as you want...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
To me, both of them are like rewards, 
heheh...
